name: Luputa

queries.query: Luputa Democratic Republic of the Congo official cadastral parcel map land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery found the official DRC Ministry of Land Affairs circumscriptions directory and the official public-service description of cadastral/land-registry consultation. The directory lists two Lomami land circumscriptions, Mwene-Ditu and Kabinda, but no Luputa entry; no Luputa-specific public map/API was found.

queries.query: Luputa République démocratique du Congo cadastre carte parcelles registre foncier officiel
queries.result: La recherche de première partie a trouvé l'annuaire officiel des circonscriptions foncières du Ministère des Affaires Foncières et la procédure officielle de consultation des registres. Pour la province du Lomami, l'annuaire publie Mwene-Ditu et Kabinda, sans entrée Luputa; aucune carte ou API publique propre à Luputa n'a été trouvée.

officialSourceAssessment.nationalCadastreService: Ministère des Affaires Foncières de la République démocratique du Congo; official procedures identify the Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre as the custodians for formal parcel-register searches.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: A national official registry/cadastre procedure is evidenced, but no Luputa local custodian, map layer, or anonymous parcel endpoint is evidenced.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: null is used because the evidence establishes a national procedure only; it does not establish a Luputa-local registry or public parcel map.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not attempted against a parcel API because no public Luputa-specific cadastral endpoint was exposed. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official DRC national land-registry/cadastre procedure and published circumscriptions directory; separate BIC public-site discovery was also checked.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: National procedure prose and a published list of Lomami circumscriptions; no Luputa parcel geometry or city extent.

serialReviewerQualification: required; no parcel adapter evidence was produced
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point [-7.16863260718852, 23.718806086014] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and was not shifted.
No exact-point hit, map extent miss, login wall, or unusable UI is treated as evidence of citywide absence.
The Ministry's directory is national administrative evidence, not proof that Luputa has no local cadastral records.
No raw source-specific attribute set, owner data, address data, or title data was requested or retained.
No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or TLS verification disablement was used.
uncertainty: A formal national land-registry/cadastre search route is documented, but Luputa-local custody, public parcel geometry, native IDs, CRS, and citywide coverage remain unresolved. Packet completion records research only; it is not source integration or runtime admission.
